findings.summary: Changing obj.(Mock) to obj.(*Mock) in AssertExpectationsForObjects breaks the deprecated by-value calling style: a Mock value falls through to an unchecked obj.(assertExpectationser) assertion and panics.
A plain *Mock now matches the new branch and wrongly logs the 'Deprecated' message, though passing a *Mock is not the deprecated style.
Removing the `m.mutex = &sync.Mutex{}` reset in On changes behavior if a mock was copied or reused while its mutex was held.
The mutex is now a value, so any code copying a Mock by value copies a lock (go vet copylocks) and is unsafe if copied while locked; tests and other packages should be checked for such copies.
